## Public clarification requested

Describe the broken link, typo, contradictory public instruction, or general ambiguity.

## Challenge or file

Link to the public file and section.

## Candidate assumption

If this affects your submission, state the assumption you plan to use. Do not ask for private role-specific guidance or approval of your approach.

## Issue policy

Please do not request sample answers, private benchmarks, hidden criteria, role-specific coaching, confidential company details, or reviewer preferences. Those requests will not be answered publicly. State reasonable assumptions in your submission instead.
